parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's Chen2020_composite parameter set, for an LG M50 cell with a graphite and silicon negative electrode (Ai et al. 2022, after Chen et al. 2020). Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpowsour.2022.231142 as implemented in PyBaMM's Chen2020_composite parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.94 mV RMS and 0.065% capacity (DFN discharges from 0.05C to 2C, and at 1C 20 K warmer).
